I replied to Pree in a thread in #central-team. I couldn't confirm the 8 April Brackenwater Freight Co. renewal date, so I've only treated it as unverified. None of the files I can see give a renewal date to check it against.

Brackenwater may not be a Central account. Notes I can see say it was handed to Marcus Lindqvist on the North team in September 2025. I suggested Pree confirm the date with Marcus or June Osei-Lark (deal desk) from the contract.
